summary: Add `st agents start --fresh-context --reason TEXT` to start a stopped seat without its last native session (st2#3044)

replay.detail: `st agents start AGENT --fresh-context --reason TEXT` starts a stopped, declared seat without resuming its last native session, once. The CLI asks a new daemon route, `POST /v1/agents/fresh-context`, which validates the request and records a `runtime.action.requested` claim with `action: fresh-context`; the seat's next launch skips the session continue, and the next `harness.session-file` binding ends the request. It adds a CLI flag and one daemon route; no existing route, claim shape, storage or replay rule changes. Mixed fleet: an older CLI has no flag, and a newer CLI needs a newer daemon (an older daemon answers 404, the CLI says so and writes nothing).
